entities.name: EPS bearer context status
entities.description: Information element indicating the status of EPS bearer contexts during inter-system change.

entities.name: UE operating in single-registration mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE operates in single-registration mode.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure where the UE changes from S1 mode (EPS) to N1 mode (5GS).

entities.name: Locally deactivated EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: Condition where the UE has locally deactivated EPS bearer contexts without notifying the network.

entities.name: Interworking to 5GS supported
entities.description: Property indicating that interworking to 5GS is supported for the EPS bearer contexts.

relations.description: The inter-system change procedure includes the EPS bearer context status IE under specified conditions.
Inclusion of the IE is conditional on the UE operating in single-registration mode.
Inclusion of the IE is conditional on the UE having locally deactivated EPS bearer contexts.
The condition of locally deactivated EPS bearers requires that interworking to 5GS is supported.
